name: 1080p home projector
description: Full-HD projector with HDMI and USB inputs, 3000 lumens and a built-in speaker. Throws a 100-inch image from about 3m. Ideal for film nights, football and garden screenings. Remote included.

name: 55-inch 4K TV
description: 55-inch 4K smart TV with three HDMI ports and streaming apps. Sharp picture and even backlight. No stand included — it is set up for wall mounting, but the VESA bracket is here to borrow.

name: Games console with two controllers
description: Current-generation games console with two wireless controllers and a few family games installed. HDMI cable and power supply included. The console is reset to factory settings before each loan.

name: Camera drone with extra battery
description: Foldable camera drone that shoots 1080p video and stabilised stills. Two batteries give about 45 minutes total. Includes a controller, spare props and a carry case. Please check local flight rules.

name: 10-inch tablet
description: Ten-inch tablet with a keyboard case and a stylus. Good for streaming, reading, email and taking notes. Battery holds a full day of light use. Charger and a protective sleeve included.

name: Soundbar with subwoofer
description: Soundbar with a wireless subwoofer for a much clearer film and sport experience. HDMI ARC and optical inputs. Pairs with the supplied remote. The subwoofer needs a nearby power socket.

name: 27-inch QHD monitor
description: 27-inch 1440p monitor with an HDMI and a DisplayPort input, plus a height-adjustable stand. Sharp text for study or work, and 75Hz for casual gaming. Two cables included.

name: Wireless printer and scanner
description: Colour inkjet printer with a flatbed scanner and duplex printing. Connects over Wi-Fi or USB. Takes standard cartridges. The feed rollers work reliably; a new black cartridge is fitted.

name: VR headset, 128GB
description: Standalone VR headset with 128GB of storage and two controllers. Great for games, workouts and virtual tours. Includes a carry case and a lens cleaning cloth. Straps are adjustable.

name: Portable air conditioner, 9000 BTU
description: Portable 9000 BTU air conditioner for bedrooms and small living rooms. Cools, dehumidifies and fans. Includes a window vent kit and a remote. Needs an outside vent; the hose is 1.5m.

name: Smart speaker with screen
description: Countertop smart display that plays music, shows recipes and makes video calls. Works with the main voice assistants. Includes a stand and a charger. Ideal for a kitchen or a home office.

name: 500Wh portable power station
description: Rechargeable power station with AC, USB and 12V outputs. Runs a fridge, a laptop or power tools for a few hours. Charges from mains or a car. Useful for camping, load-shedding or a stall.

name: Folding treadmill
description: Foldable treadmill with 12 programmes and a 12km/h top speed. Folds upright to save space. The belt is clean and runs true. Recommended for walking and light jogging rather than sprint training.

name: Adjustable dumbbells, pair of 24kg
description: Two adjustable dumbbells from 2 to 24kg each, with a quick-dial selector. Replaces a whole rack and fits under a bed. The mechanisms are smooth and the plates are free of rust.

name: Yoga mat and blocks set
description: 6mm non-slip yoga mat with two cork blocks and a strap. Used indoors, cleaned after every session. Rolls up into the included carry strap. Good for yoga, pilates or stretching.

name: Kettlebell set, 6 to 16kg
description: Three cast-iron kettlebells — 6kg, 10kg and 16kg — with a wide handle for two-handed swings. Great for swings, squats, presses and carries. The bases are flat and the paint is intact.

name: Rowing machine
description: Air-resistance rower with a smooth stroke and an LCD monitor showing time, distance and calories. Folds for storage. The seat rolls freely and the chain was oiled recently. Very quiet.

name: Magnetic exercise bike
description: Upright exercise bike with eight resistance levels and a heart-rate display. Adjustable seat and handlebars. Very quiet, so it suits a flat. Castors make it easy to move. Pedals have straps.

name: Resistance band set
description: Five latex resistance bands with different strengths, plus handles, ankle straps and a door anchor. Packs into a small bag for travel or a hotel room. One band shows light wear but still stretches well.

name: Boxing gloves and pads
description: Pair of 12oz boxing gloves with two focus pads and hand wraps. The padding is still firm and the lining has been cleaned. Good for pad work, fitness boxing and learning the basics.

name: Badminton set with net
description: Portable badminton net with two posts, four rackets and a tube of shuttles. Sets up in a garden or hall in about ten minutes. The net has no tears. Rackets are strung and the grips are fresh.

name: Hardtail mountain bike, 29er
description: Large-frame 29er hardtail with a 1x11 drivetrain and hydraulic disc brakes. Tyres have plenty of tread. Recently serviced: new brake pads and a tuned derailleur. Suits riders around 1.80m.

name: Aluminium road bike, 54cm
description: 54cm aluminium road frame with a carbon fork and 22-speed gearing. Light and quick on tarmac. Includes clipless pedals and two bottle cages. A small paint chip on the top tube, no cracks.

name: Bike repair stand
description: Height-adjustable repair stand that clamps the seatpost or frame, leaving both wheels free to spin. 360-degree rotating clamp and a tool tray. Folds flat. Essential for drivetrain and brake work.

name: Floor pump with gauge
description: Steel floor pump with a 160psi gauge and a dual Presta/Schrader head. Inflates a road tyre in a few strokes. The hose is reinforced and the base is stable. Ideal for weekly tyre checks.

name: Tow-bar bike rack, 3 bikes
description: Tow-bar mounted rack that carries three bikes, with a tilt function for boot access and a locking arm. Fits a standard 50mm tow ball. Lights and number plate holder work. Bikes not included.

name: Kids' 20-inch bike
description: Twenty-inch kids' bike for roughly ages six to nine, with six gears, a light frame and training-wheel mounts. Brakes adjusted and tyres pumped. The saddle and grips are in good condition.

name: Adult kick scooter
description: Folding adult scooter with 200mm wheels, a rear brake and an adjustable bar. Folds in one movement for the bus or boot. Good for short commutes and park paths. Weight limit 100kg.

name: Electric city bike, 60km range
description: Step-through electric bike with a 60km assisted range, five power levels and a removable battery. Includes a charger, lights and a rear rack. Brakes and gears were serviced this month.
